name: Coinbene

descriptions.text: Crypptocurrency expert Nick Schteringard said on Twitter yesterday, that the hacker appears to have stolen roughly $6 million in Coinbene Coin and $39 million in Maximine Coin, which it later dumped on the market.

CoinBene's Ethereum hot wallet experienced large, unauthorized outflows of ERC-20 tokens on March 25, 2019, totaling over $45 million as externally estimated. The event is generally attributed to suspected wallet compromise or failed access controls, but no technical root cause was disclosed. Loss figures reflect tokens moved, not confirmed unrecoverable loss. Unauthorized wallet transfers consistent with hot-wallet key compromise or failed privileged access controls. No technical vulnerability, contract bug, or detailed method was disclosed by CoinBene.
